entities.name: Lidiya Shulaykina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lidiya Ivanovna Shulaykina was one of the few women Ilyushin Il-2 pilots and the only female ground-attack pilot in naval aviation during the Second World War. In 1993 she was awarded the title Hero of the Russian Federation.
